title: sweep-line events and active intervals
concepts: A sweep-line algorithm sorts event coordinates and processes them in order while maintaining a compact summary of objects currently active at the sweep position.
An interval contributes start and end events; event ordering at equal coordinates must match whether endpoints are closed, open, or half-open.
For maximum simultaneous overlap, a counter is sufficient; when active objects must be identified or ranked, an ordered set, heap, or frequency structure may be required.
A min-heap of end times can release resources whose intervals have finished before processing a new interval, yielding room or machine counts after sorting starts.
A sweep is often O(n log n) because events are sorted or active structures perform logarithmic updates; the scan itself is linear.
Two-dimensional sweeps transform geometric boundaries into events but require a precisely defined active structure and careful tie ordering.
Coordinate compression maps a finite set of event coordinates to dense indices while preserving order, enabling array or tree data structures over large coordinates.
The sweep state must be sufficient to answer the query; keeping only an overlap count cannot answer which intervals overlap or compute arbitrary geometric unions.

practiceProblems.name: Meeting Rooms II
practiceProblems.statement: Given meeting intervals [start,end), return the minimum number of rooms required so all meetings can take place without overlap.

practiceProblems.name: Car Pooling
practiceProblems.statement: Each trip [passengers,from,to] boards at from and exits at to while the car travels east. Return whether occupancy ever exceeds capacity; drop-offs occur before pickups at the same location.

practiceProblems.name: My Calendar I
practiceProblems.statement: Implement a calendar that accepts a half-open event [start,end) only when it has no nonempty overlap with an existing event. A rejected booking does not change the calendar.

practiceProblems.name: My Calendar III
practiceProblems.statement: After each booking [start,end), return the largest number of events that overlap at any time among all bookings so far.

practiceProblems.name: Number of Flowers in Full Bloom
practiceProblems.statement: For each person's arrival time, return the number of flowers whose inclusive bloom interval [start,end] contains that time.

practiceProblems.name: The Skyline Problem
practiceProblems.statement: Given grounded rectangular buildings [left,right,height], return sorted skyline key points, merging consecutive equal-height segments and ending with height zero.
constraints: Buildings are sorted by left coordinate
